# PuroAir

> > PuroAir manufactures HEPA air purifiers and replacement filters designed to remove up to 99.9% of air pollutants including allergens, pet dander, dust, and VOCs from homes of all sizes.

PuroAir offers a comprehensive range of smart and standard air purifiers from compact models (100i) to large-room solutions (400), along with HVAC filters and a convenient Subscribe & Save program for automatic filter replacements. The product line includes WiFi-enabled models with mobile app control and voice compatibility for seamless smart home integration.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filtration
- Air quality
- Smart air purifiers
- WiFi-enabled control
- Filter replacement
- Subscribe & Save
- Allergen removal
- VOC removal
- HVAC filters
- MERV 13
- Mobile app control
- Voice control
- Auto-delivery
- Whole-home purification
- CarbonTech
